<!--
Measured, not read: the APA journals indent a block quotation on the left
only. It stands 16pt in from the column's left edge, as the Group Dynamics
article in quote.pdf at the repository root sets one, and its
full lines run to the column's right edge, the edge the justified body text
runs to. Both formats indented it on both sides, and by different amounts:
LaTeX's 2.5em in the .pdf, a quarter of an inch in typst.

The other modes keep the right indent (layout-document.qmd).
-->

Alphaone alphatwo.

> Quoteone words of a quotation long enough that it has to run on to several lines in a column, so that its full lines can be measured from end to end against the text block, quotelast.

Bodyone words of a body paragraph long enough that it has to run on to several lines in a column, so that its full lines can be measured from end to end against the text block, bodylast.
